messages:
laura_marketing: Quick check-in  we need final X + LinkedIn copy variants, hero image crops, and exact UTM keys for the webinar bump. Goal: schedule Wed morning across regions. Jenna can you queue if assets are in by EOD? :calendar:

miguel_content: Yes, I'll deliver two copy sets + a short video clip. Proposal: Variant 1 = data-first (bench highlights), Variant 2 = customer story (pain -> solution -> result).

jenna_social: If assets land by 5pm PT I can stagger posts across NA/EU/APAC windows. Do we want the LI post expanded into a carousel or keep single-link?

sam_growth: Carousel on LI is good for conversions. For routing, add UTM param `traffic_bucket` with values `dataA`/`storyB`. Map `dataA` leads -> `sdr-bench` queue, `storyB` -> `sdr-growth`. Also flag high-intent clicks (>=2 page views) for an immediate outreach.

laura_marketing: Agreed on UTMs. Also prefer soft CTAs: "save your spot" for the X copy and "register" on LI. Please avoid absolute % claims in copy until legal signs off. @legal_bot can you run a quick sweep on the benchmark wording later today?

legal_bot: I'll review. Quick heads-up: language like "cut costs 2x" may need substantiation. If you give me the benchmark doc, I can approve a compliant phrasing within 2 hours.

miguel_content: Draft copy here  please pick edits.

X Variant Data (short): Cut inference cost and tame tail latency. Save your spot for our webinar: [link]?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_term=dataA&utm_content=hero

X Variant Story (short): They were spending too much on latency. We redesigned serving and the result was dramatic. Save your spot: [link]?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_term=storyB&utm_content=hero

LinkedIn Variant Data (long): Benchmark summary + 3 slides showing cost vs latency tradeoffs. CTA: register. Tags: #MLOps #Inference #Benchmarking

LinkedIn Variant Story (carousel): 4 cards: problem, approach, result, invite. CTA: register. Tags: #AI #SRE

jenna_social: I'll prepare both LI carousel and single-link fallback. Miguel  please confirm we have 1:1 + 9:16 video exports and a 1200x628 hero. Also note: we'll pin the X post for 36h and TTL pin after that.

miguel_content: Exports ready: 9:16 vertical clip, 1:1 feed clip, 1200x628 hero + 1080x1080 crop. Uploaded to: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar_assets/176945 (preview link).

scheduler_bot: Drafts queued: x_data_176945, x_story_176945, li_data_carousel_176945, li_story_carousel_176945. Preview: https://scheduler.internal/drafts/176945

sam_growth: Monitoring plan: first 2 hours live monitoring for replies, then hourly checks for 24h. I'll lead triage first 60 mins and hand off to community ops. Templates ready: quick reply, invite DM, enterprise hook. Testing note: include `traffic_bucket` in the webhook payload to CRM.

olivia_ops: I'll wire a consumer to tag leads by `traffic_bucket` and push to HubSpot with a custom field `origin_bucket`. Staging consumer created, will run one end-to-end test during the first scheduled post.

laura_marketing: Two tiny asks before EOD: 1) Miguel, soften any numeric claims until legal says go; 2) Jenna, set timezone-aware slots for NA morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening. If both done, I give go-ahead to lock schedule.

miguel_content: Will change phrasing to "performance improvements" where needed and ping legal doc link.

legal_bot: Reviewed quick pass  approved removing the explicit "2x" phrasing. Recommended language: "significant cost and latency improvements" unless you want to cite the benchmark doc.

jenna_social: Slots set. I'll post exact UTC times in #calendar once the drafts are locked. Also will add `traffic_bucket` UTM to each scheduled URL.

laura_marketing: Great. Closing action items: assets in drive (miguel), copy with UTMs (miguel + laura), scheduler drafts (jenna + scheduler_bot), CRM routing + webhook (olivia + sam), legal clearance (legal_bot). Will reconvene post-launch for engagement follow-ups. :tada:
